local _M={}
function _M:timedEffects(filter)
	local todel = {}
	local def
	local effs = {}
	for eff, p in pairs(self.tmp) do
		effs[eff] = p
	end
	for eff, p in pairs(effs) do
		def = _M.tempeffect_def[eff]
		if not filter or filter(def, p) then
			if p.dur <= 0 then
				todel[#todel+1] = eff
			else
				if def.on_timeout then
					local old_source
					if p.src then
						old_source = p.src.__project_source
						p.src.__project_source = p 
					end -- intermediate projector source
					if def.on_timeout(self, p, def) then
						todel[#todel+1] = eff
					end
					if p.src then p.src.__project_source = old_source end
				end
			end
			p.dur = p.dur - def.decrease
		end
	end

	while #todel > 0 do
		self:removeEffect(table.remove(todel))
	end
end
local hits={}
DamageType={PHYSICAL=1}
function DamageType:get() return {projector=function(_,_,_,_,dam) hits[#hits+1]=dam end} end
_M.tempeffect_def={[1]={decrease=1,on_timeout=function(self,eff)
		DamageType:get(DamageType.PHYSICAL).projector(eff.src or self, self.x, self.y, DamageType.PHYSICAL, eff.dam)
		eff.dam = eff.dam * (1 + eff.mult)
end}}
local actor=setmetatable({x=0,y=0,tmp={}}, {__index=_M})
function actor:removeEffect(id) self.tmp[id]=nil end
local tickcases=0
for _,base in ipairs({1,20,123.4}) do
 for _,mult in ipairs({0.25,0.4,0.75}) do
  hits={};actor.tmp={[1]={dur=4,dam=base,mult=mult}}
  for i=1,5 do actor:timedEffects() end
  assert(#hits==4 and actor.tmp[1]==nil)
  local total=0
  for i=1,4 do assert(math.abs(hits[i]-base*(1+mult)^(i-1))<1e-9);total=total+hits[i] end
  local display=base*(1+(1+mult)^2+(1+mult)^3+(1+mult)^4)
  assert(display>total)
  tickcases=tickcases+1
 end
end
util={bound=function(x,a,b) return math.min(math.max(x,a),b) end}
local function mitigate(base,cp,reduction)
 local dam,crit_power,ignore_direct_crits=base*cp,cp,reduction
			dam = dam / crit_power
			local reduce = (crit_power - 1) * (util.bound(ignore_direct_crits, 0, 100) / 100)
			crit_power = math.max(1, crit_power - reduce)
			dam = dam * crit_power
 return dam
end
local cc=0
for _,cp in ipairs({1.2,1.5,2,3}) do
 for _,r in ipairs({0,20,50,100,120}) do
  local expected=100*(1+(cp-1)*(1-math.min(r,100)/100))
  assert(math.abs(mitigate(100,cp,r)-expected)<1e-9);cc=cc+1
 end
end
local distvalue=0
core={fov={distance=function() return distvalue end}}
local function aiming(distance,power)
 distvalue=distance
 local self={knowTalent=true,T_AIM=1,__CLASSNAME='mod.class.Actor',isTalentActive=function()return true end,callTalent=function()return power end}
 local target={};local dam=100
		if self and dam > 0 and self.knowTalent and self:isTalentActive(self.T_AIM) and self.__CLASSNAME ~= "mod.class.Grid" then
			local dist = math.min(math.max(0, core.fov.distance(self.x, self.y, target.x, target.y) - 3),8)
			if dist > 0 then 
				local dammult = self:callTalent(self.T_AIM, "getDamage") * dist 
				dam = dam * (1 + (dammult/100))
			end
		end
 return dam
end
local ac=0
for _,p in ipairs({2,4.5,7.9}) do
 for d=0,15 do assert(math.abs(aiming(d,p)-(100+p*math.min(math.max(d-3,0),8)))<1e-9);ac=ac+1 end
 assert(math.abs(aiming(8,p)-(100+5*p))<1e-9)
 assert(math.abs(aiming(11,p)-(100+8*p))<1e-9)
end
local jc=0
for _,dam_mult in ipairs({1,1.5,2.25}) do
 local result
 local self={getObjectCombat=function()return {} end,attackTargetWith=function(_,_,_,_,m)result=m;return 1,true end}
 local target={};local speed,hit
		speed, hit = self:attackTargetWith(target, self:getObjectCombat(nil, "barehand"), nil, dam_mult+1.25)
 assert(result==dam_mult+1.25 and result~=dam_mult*1.25);jc=jc+1
end
print('PASS: '..tickcases..' actual four-tick Touch of Death cases; '..cc..' excess-critical-power reductions; '..ac..' Aim distance samples; '..jc..' Offhand Jab additive multipliers')
